label: false_positive
rationale: The h4 '+1 (888) 414 0100' sits right under the 'PHONE' label (img alt 'Phone', visible as a section label in the screenshot). The only content under it is the extension menu for that same number ('x 0 General inquiries / x 1 RightsCon info'). So the heading names exactly what the section is about, and someone navigating by headings knows it is the phone number. The judgment's claim that it 'says nothing about the content under it' is wrong. The proposed fix 'General inquiries phone number' would also be less accurate, because the number serves both general inquiries (x0) and RightsCon (x1). 2.4.6 asks for a descriptive heading, not a label-style one, and the number is the topic here.
